start.text: You found it! Did the guard send you to Prakash? He sends everyone to Prakash. Come, induction is upstairs.

ontime.text: Nine twenty-eight. I like you already. Prakash gave the card? Good. Come up — induction, then I'll show you your desk. Window seat, don't get used to it.

late.text: (She looks at her watch, then at you, then decides not to say it.) Autos? Everyone's first Monday is autos. Tomorrow, leave twenty minutes early. Come, induction has started.

go.text: Laptop comes from IT on Wednesday — IT is IT. Till then, read the wiki and meet the team. Sameer sits behind you; he talks. That's useful.

evening.text: Day one done. Go home, eat something that isn't from a machine. Nine-thirty tomorrow.

hivr.text: There you are. HIVR want someone on site for AMR-07 — today. You built half that screen, so you go. Hebbal, the visitor block.

hivr_2.text: (She looks tired. She doesn't say why.) Take the evening, come in late tomorrow. Laptop's at your desk — grab it and go.

after_hivr.text: You went. Good. Write it up when you're back.
